request.query: For a finite multivariate polynomial expansion over a NormedCommRing with NormOneClass, strict coefficient norm bound and vanishing of terms below a real coordinate cost threshold, bound the norm of evaluation by cardinality times coefficient bound times real power decay

items.informal_description: Let $ f $ be a multilinear map satisfying $ \|f(m)\| = 0 $ whenever $ \|m_i\| = 0 $ for some coordinate $ i $. Given positive real numbers $ \varepsilon_i $ and scalars $ c_i $ with $ \|c_i\| > 1 $, if $ \|f(m)\| \leq C \prod_i \|m_i\| $ holds for all $ m $ such that $ \varepsilon_i / \|c_i\| \leq \|m_i\| < \varepsilon_i $, then this inequality holds for all $ m $ in the product space.

items.type:

  ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.numBound k D (n + 1) =
    ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.numBound k D n * ChevalleyThm.MvPolynomialC.degBound k D n * D n
items.informal_description: For natural numbers $k, n$ and function $D : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the numerical bound at $n+1$ satisfies $\text{numBound}(k, D, n+1) = \text{numBound}(k, D, n) \cdot \text{degBound}(k, D, n) \cdot D(n)$, establishing a recursive relationship used in well-founded recursion for multivariate polynomials in Chevalley's theorem.

items.informal_name: Bound for Multilinear Maps on Norm Shells
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} {ι : Type v} {E : ι → Type wE} {G : Type wG} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → NormedAddCommGroup (E i)] [inst_3 : (i : ι) → NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)]
  [inst_4 : SeminormedAddCommGroup G] [inst_5 : NormedSpace 𝕜 G] (f : MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) {ε : ι → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
  {c : ι → 𝕜},
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 < ε i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 1 < ‖c i‖) →
      (∀ (m : (i : ι) → E i), (∀ (i : ι), ε i / ‖c i‖ ≤ ‖m i‖) → (∀ (i : ι), ‖m i‖ < ε i) → ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m...
items.informal_description: Let $ f $ be a multilinear map from $ \prod_{i \in \iota} E_i $ to $ G $ over a normed field $ \mathbb{K} $. Suppose $ \varepsilon_i > 0 $ and $ \|c_i\| > 1 $ for all $ i $. If for all $ m \in \prod_{i \in \iota} E_i $, the condition $ \frac{\varepsilon_i}{\|c_i\|} \leq \|m_i\| < \varepsilon_i $ implies $ \|f(m)\| \leq C \prod_{i} \|m_i\| $, then for all $ m $, $ \|f(m)\| \leq C \prod_{i} \|m_i\| $. This establishes a norm bound for $ f $ under shell-like constraints on its inputs.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ), p.mahlerMeasure ≤ p.sum fun x a => ‖a‖
items.informal_description: For any complex polynomial $ p $, its Mahler measure satisfies $ \text{Mahler}(p) \leq \sum_{n} \|a_n\| $, where $ a_n $ are the coefficients of $ p $ and $ \|\cdot\| $ denotes the complex norm.
